name: LADD
hero: Hello, LADD. This is my new site - part work timeline, part design-system playground. Open the settings and mess with the themes; that's half the reason it exists. And the honest part: I'm looking for my next full-time team, so if yours needs a design lead, keep scrolling.

milestones.2026-job-search: This is the real reason I'm sharing here - the good roles come through people, not portals. If your team (or one you know) needs someone who designs and ships, I'd love an intro.
milestones.world-ia-day-2026: Some of you were there - or spoke, or volunteered. Chairing it was my favorite way to meet the LA design community all over again.
milestones.pxl: Proof that meetups work: I met PXL's creative technologist at the Ember meetup, and that turned into DreamWorks.com. Keep showing up to things.
milestones.open-office-hours: This one's for you, not recruiters. If you want a second set of eyes on your portfolio or a design-system problem at work, book a slot - it's free.
